title: Lemosho Route Group Departure · 8 days · Group
content:
Embark on an unforgettable group adventure climbing Kilimanjaro via the Lemosho Route. Your journey begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport, followed by a smooth transfer to your hotel, where you’ll meet fellow climbers. Here, our experienced guides will provide a detailed briefing, setting the stage for your trek. Enjoy the hotel’s amenities, including a pool, garden, bar, and restaurant, ensuring a relaxing and comfortable start to your adventure.

The trek kicks off with a group transfer to Lemosho Park Gate for registration, followed by a hike through lush forest trails to Mti Mkubwa Camp. Over the next few days, you and your group will ascend through spectacular landscapes, including Shira 1 and Shira 2 camps, the Lava Tower, and the iconic Barranco Wall. Each day brings new challenges and stunning scenery, fostering camaraderie among group members as you work toward your shared goal of reaching Uhuru Peak.

After celebrating your summit success, you will descend to Mweka Camp before returning to the hotel for a hot meal and well-deserved rest. Reflect on your achievement with your group and share stories of the climb. Optional post-trek extensions include safaris and trips to Zanzibar, offering additional opportunities to explore Tanzania’s natural and cultural beauty.

This group departure itinerary is designed to deliver an enriching experience, combining teamwork, adventure, and comfort, while showcasing the best of Tanzania’s wonders.

faqs.title: How long does it take to climb Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: The duration of a Kilimanjaro climb typically ranges from 5 to 10 days, depending on the chosen route and your acclimatization needs. Longer treks allow for better acclimatization and increase the chances of reaching the summit.

faqs.title: What is the best time to climb Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: The best times to climb are during the dry seasons, which run from late June to October and from mid-January to March. These months generally offer clearer skies and better weather conditions.

faqs.title: Do I need to be an experienced climber to summit Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: No previous climbing experience is necessary to summit Kilimanjaro. However, a good level of physical fitness, preparation, and understanding of altitude sickness are important for a successful climb.

faqs.title: What are the different routes to climb Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: There are several routes to summit Kilimanjaro, including the Marangu, Machame, Lemosho, and Rongai routes. Each varies in difficulty, scenery, and duration, so choose one that aligns with your preferences and fitness level.

faqs.title: What should I pack for climbing Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: Essential gear includes layered clothing, a waterproof jacket, sturdy hiking boots, a sleeping bag rated for cold temperatures, trekking poles, a headlamp, and personal items like sunscreen, a hat, and a water bottle. Consult your tour operator for a comprehensive packing list.

faqs.title: How high is Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: Mount Kilimanjaro stands at approximately 5,895 meters (19,341 feet) above sea level, making it the highest peak in Africa.

faqs.title: What is altitude sickness, and how can I prevent it?
faqs.content: Altitude sickness occurs when your body struggles to acclimatize to high elevations, leading to symptoms like headache, nausea, and fatigue. To minimize the risk, ascend slowly, stay hydrated, and consider taking a medication like Diamox. Listen to your body and communicate with your guides.

faqs.title: Are there age restrictions for climbing Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: Yes, climbers must be at least 10 years old to trek Kilimanjaro, and those under 18 should be accompanied by an adult. Some operators have specific age limits, so check with your chosen tour company.

faqs.title: Will I need a guide to climb Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: Yes, all climbers are required to go with a licensed guide and a support team. This is essential for safety, navigation, and to comply with Tanzanian regulations.

faqs.title: What is the success rate for reaching the summit?
faqs.content: Success rates vary by route, but generally hover around 50-65% for shorter treks. Longer routes that allow for better acclimatization tend to have higher success rates, often exceeding 80%.

faqs.title: Is there a chance of communication during the climb?
faqs.content: You may have limited cell phone coverage on certain routes, but it’s advisable to expect minimal connectivity. Most trekkers focus on enjoying the experience and the beautiful surroundings rather than staying connected.

itinerary.title: Day 1
itinerary.content:
As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be waiting to greet you with a sign displaying your name, offering a warm welcome. Following this, you’ll enjoy a seamless transfer to the charming

Hotel

, where you can relax and unwind. Upon your arrival, a delicious meal will be served to you.

Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing. This informative session is an exciting opportunity for you to learn about the adventure that lies ahead and the various wonders you will encounter during your expedition.

The Hotel provides a relaxing atmosphere, complete with a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant, ensuring a comfortable start to your Kilimanjaro adventure.

Overnight: Sal salinero hotel or similar

itinerary.title: Day 2
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 2,200 m - 2,780 m
  • Hiking distance: 7 km
  • Hiking time: 5 hours time

On your first day, you’ll begin with breakfast and a briefing from your guide at your

Hotel

. Following this, you’ll embark on a

1.5-hour drive

to

Lemosho Park Gate

(2,100m). Once you arrive at

Lemosho Gate

, you’ll complete the necessary registration before starting your trek.

Your adventure begins with a hike along scenic forest trails to

Mti Mkubwa Campsite

(2,750m). This trek typically takes around

3 hours

. Upon reaching the campsite, the porters will set up your tents, and our chef will prepare a delicious lunch for you.

After enjoying your meal, you’ll have some time to relax and acclimate to your surroundings. In the evening, your guide will provide a briefing about the next day’s trek, ensuring you’re well-prepared for the adventures that lie ahead.

This day sets the tone for your expedition, combining travel, nature, and preparation for the exciting days to come.

itinerary.title: Day 3
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 2,780 m – 3,500 m
  • Hiking distance: 8 km
  • Hiking time: 4 to 5 hours

On the second day, you’ll start your morning early with breakfast before setting off on a trek from

Mti Mkubwa Camp

to

Shira 1 Camp

. This hike typically takes up to

5 hours

and offers spectacular views of the west face of

Kibo Volcano

, the highest peak of Kilimanjaro. As you traverse the lower moorland zone, you’ll encounter large shrubs and vibrant wildflowers that add to the stunning scenery. Upon reaching

Shira 1 Camp

, our porters will set up your tents while the chef prepares a nourishing lunch.

After enjoying your meal, you’ll have some well-deserved time to relax and acclimate to the altitude. In the evening, your guide will hold a briefing to discuss the plans for the next day’s trek, ensuring you’re informed and ready for the adventure ahead.

This day offers not only a chance to make progress on your climb but also to appreciate the diverse flora and breathtaking views that Kilimanjaro has to offer.

itinerary.title: Day 4
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,500m – 3,840 m
  • Hiking distance: 5 km
  • Hiking time: 3 -4 hours

On the third day, you’ll start your morning with an early breakfast before embarking on a brief hike from

Shira 1 Camp

to

Shira 2 Camp

. This trek typically takes about

5 to 6 hours

and is relatively easy, allowing you to fully enjoy the breathtaking views of the African landscape around you. Upon arrival at

Shira 2 Camp

, our dedicated porters will handle all the arrangements, including pitching your tents, while the chef prepares a delicious lunch. After your meal, you’ll have the opportunity to unwind and rest until dinnertime.

In the evening, after dinner, your experienced guide will hold a briefing to discuss the trekking plans for the following day. This day not only allows for gradual acclimatization but also offers stunning panoramic vistas, making it a memorable part of your Kilimanjaro adventure.

itinerary.title: Day 5
itinerary.desc: SHIRA CAMP 2 | LAVA TOWER | BARRANCO CAMP
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,840 m – 3,960 m
  • Hiking distance: 11 km
  • Hiking time: 7–8 hours

Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s route takes you to the

Lava Tower

at

4,630 meters

, traversing through a semi-desert, rocky landscape. This demanding hike typically takes around

5 hours

to reach the Lava Tower, where you’ll enjoy lunch amidst the stunning surroundings. After lunch, prepare for a descent of

680 meters

to

Barranco Camp

, which allows your body to adjust to the higher altitude—a key advantage of acclimatization. The

2-hour descent

offers breathtaking views and fantastic photo opportunities of the

Western Breach

, a striking feature of Kilimanjaro’s landscape.

Conclude your day with a memorable sunset and dinner at

Barranco Camp

, where you can reflect on the day’s achievements and recharge for the adventures ahead. This day is vital for acclimatization, helping you adapt to the altitude while enjoying the diverse and stunning terrains of Kilimanjaro.

itinerary.title: Day 6
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,960 m – 4,035 m
  • Hiking distance: 5 km
  • Hiking time: 5 hours

Start your day early with a wake-up call and a nourishing breakfast to fuel your trek. The journey may include ascending the famous

Barranco Wall

, a steep but rewarding section that provides breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. After conquering the Wall, you’ll descend into the scenic

Karanga Valley

, renowned for its lush vegetation and stunning vistas. Upon reaching the

Karanga Campsite

, our dedicated porters will set up your tents while our chef prepares a satisfying lunch. After your meal, you’ll embark on an acclimatization hike towards

Barafu Camp

, ascending

200 meters

before returning to camp. This acclimatization hike is essential for your body to adjust to the altitude and helps prepare you for the final summit push.

In the evening, enjoy a hot meal prepared by our chef, providing the nourishment you’ll need for the upcoming challenges. Following dinner, your experienced guide will brief you on the next day’s trek, discussing the route, challenges, and key details to ensure you’re well-prepared for the adventure ahead. This day is vital for acclimatization, allowing you to appreciate the stunning beauty of Kilimanjaro while ensuring you are physically ready for the summit attempt.

itinerary.title: Day 7
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 4,035 m – 4,640 m
  • Hiking distance: 5 km
  • Hiking time: 15+ hours

Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek toward

Barafu Campsite

. The trail features varied terrain, including rocky sections and gradual slopes, offering breathtaking views of Kilimanjaro’s high-altitude landscapes. As you ascend, it’s crucial to focus on acclimatization to minimize the risk of altitude-related issues.

Upon reaching

Barafu

, our dedicated porters will handle the setup of your camp while our chef prepares a satisfying lunch. After your meal, take time to rest and recharge until dinner. In the evening, your guide will brief you on the upcoming summit attempt, covering important details about the route, challenges, safety measures, and preparations.

Make sure to rest well this evening, as the summit ascent will begin late at night. This preparation is key for a successful climb to

Uhuru Peak

, the highest point in Africa, where you’ll experience the thrill of standing atop Kilimanjaro.

itinerary.title: Day 8
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 4,640 m – 5, 895 m – 3,090 m
  • Hiking distance: 7 km
  • Descending time: 15+ hours

On this crucial day, you’ll rise around

11:30 PM

and start your ascent after enjoying some tea and biscuits. The climb begins as you head northwest, navigating through scree toward

Stella Point

on the crater rim. The trek to Stella Point, located at

5,685 meters

, is often considered the most mentally and physically demanding portion of the climb, typically taking around

6 hours

. Upon reaching Stella Point, take a brief rest to absorb the breathtaking views and, if conditions allow, witness a magnificent sunrise. The journey continues with a

2-hour

snow-covered ascent to

Uhuru Peak

, the highest point in Africa. Your time at the summit should be brief due to the cold and potential fatigue, so make sure to capture the moment quickly.

Afterward, you will descend back to

Barafu Camp

, a trek that takes about

3 hours

, where you’ll have a chance for a short rest before continuing on to

Mweka Camp

for dinner and your overnight stay. This day is a true highlight of your Kilimanjaro adventure, culminating in a sense of accomplishment that is unmatched.

itinerary.title: Day 9
itinerary.desc: MWEKA CAMP | MWEKA PARK GATE | MOSHI
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,090 m – 1,650 m
  • Hiking distance: 10 km
  • Descending time: 4-5 hours

After breakfast at

Mweka Camp

, you’ll begin your descent to

Mweka Gate

, where you’ll complete the trek. A comfortable drive will take you back to your

Hotel

, where a hot lunch and a refreshing shower await you. At the end of your trip, tipping your guide and the support team is encouraged and appreciated; special envelopes for this purpose will be available at the hotel.

If you’re interested in extending your adventure with a

safari

, our safari coordinator will be available at the hotel to discuss various options. After some well-deserved rest, you can meet with them for a briefing on the exciting safari experiences we offer. We highly recommend booking a safari with us to explore Tanzania’s stunning wildlife and natural beauty, ensuring your journey is truly unforgettable.

Overnight: Sal salinero hotel or similar

itinerary.title: Day 10
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to

Kilimanjaro International Airport

for your departure. If you’re looking to extend your adventure, consider adding a

day trip

to your itinerary, allowing you to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture. For more information on available options, please visit our

Day Trip

page.

Alternatively, you can continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you seek relaxation on pristine beaches or wish to delve into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar has something for everyone. Explore our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next excursion.

If you’re interested in enhancing your trip with a

safari experience

, check out our

Safari

page for exciting safari options available.
